notes.title: The Game is Afoot!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34491490/9cbf8337256ba93092e3e808a069f25b518a500d.png[/img]
Hey Panda Peeps,

Do you crave more excitement in your life? How about a handsome new love interest?

Oh yeah - that got your attention, didn’t it? Good, because this is one news post you are not going to want to skim! In fact, you might want to grab a notepad and start jotting things down. Remember, no detail is too small. And trust us, it’ll be great practice for what’s to come…

Are you sitting comfortably? We’re adding Parallel Events to Blush Blush!

In the coming days, you may notice a new countdown timer at the top of your game screen. On March 24th, when the clock hits 0:00, that timer will be replaced with a mysterious button. Click it, and you’ll find yourself transported to a parallel dimension and a new, time-limited game mode! There’s new jobs and hobbies, a sumptuous new setting, and a few familiar faces you’ll get the chance to meet for the first time all over again.

You’ll have just a few days, from March 24th to March 28th, to complete your Event Goals and solve a thrilling mystery - but beware! In this dimension, you’re starting from scratch without your Reset Boosts or Time Blocks, so you’ll have to stay on top of your game if you want to outrun the clock.

But for those who dare to meet this challenge, a worthy prize awaits: a brand new fully-dateable guy, only available by completing this event! We’d tell you more about him, but what’s life without a little… mystery? 

We love you so hard,

notes.title: Early Access Complete
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34491490/e9df4c39123392804c1f5c17c954097a1f67591b.png[/img]
Hey Panda Peeps.

Can we get a little serious for a moment? A little sentimental? Can we turn down the lights a bit, put on some smooth jazz, and share a few words from the heart?

If you're a fan of Blush Blush, you may have noticed that we just recently hit our 1 year anniversary. We've been tinkering away at Blush Blush for 1 year as of April 4th. And what a time it's been. 

When we originally set out to build Blush Blush, we had super mixed emotions on whether it would work or not. At the time, we didn't see a lot of games like Blush Blush out there. There were, of course, plenty of dating sims. Plenty with smexy or beautiful bois, to be sure. But not many with the kind of "fun and flirty" vibe we like to go for.

We were nervous to devote our entire studio to the gig, so we decided to do a slower roll out. Put the game out piece by piece, take our time, and see if anyone was interested. 

And holy smokes, everyone. Here you are. 

We are so over the moon that you guys and gals have given us so much of your time. So many of your suggestions, so much of your passion and support. We've seen so much incredible cosplay and fanart, received so many messages of support, and learned a thing or two along the way.

We have never felt better, as a studio, that the stuff we're making is being appreciated. That we made the right choices when it comes to the stories we want to tell, and the kinds of games we want to build. 

So from the bottom of our hearts - thank you all. Thanks for being so awesome. For supporting us, and taking this journey with us.

We are proud to announce that Blush Blush is officially out of Early Access. One year later, the game and its fans are trucking along, being fun and flirty and fantastic. 

What does the future hold? No idea. We're in the middle of building lots of other stuff. But if you like what you see, or if you have suggestions on stuff we should consider next, please let us know. We dig into your feedback, debate it, blush at it, and ultimately embrace it.

Any good game studio worth its salt is only that way because of its fans.

Thank you. We love you all so hard.

--
The Pandas

Hey Blushing Baes,

It's been an exciting week for Blush Blush! We just got a huge surge of new peeps playing the game (thanks to a certain charming Youtuber), at the same time we've been finishing up a bunch of internal work for the game's future releases. Noice!

Whether you're new to Blush Blush, or a veteran of the man-imal quest, you might be wondering what's around the corner. The game has been in Beta for a few months, and so far we've been making updates on the slow-ish side, as we wrap up a bunch of details.

Well, we're here to reveal our evil plans! Only they're not evil - they're scandalous at best. Either way, here's a list of our timeline and features that you can expect coming up in the next couple months:
[list]
[*] New character! Putting the "goat" in "GOAT", early next month we'll be adding "William" to the cast. He's a sexy veterinarian who's a little more on the sophisticated side.

[*] Mobile edition! We'll be launching Blush Blush on mobile in the next two months(ish)! Look to flirt with your favorite fellas on your phone! So cute!

[*] Phone Flings! We've got a bunch of fun and flirty guys almost ready, who'll be fighting for your attention. And if you don't know what a "Phone Fling" is - they're awesome little side stories where you can chat with guys and earn some selfies!

[/list]

We crazy appreciate all our fans, new and experienced, and hope you'll all continue to support Blush Blush as we finish up our dress rehearsal and move onto the big show. 

Thanks for everything. Keep sending us your ideas, and stay tuned for more surprises and fun stuff. 

Love you all so hard!
